mapper.sql: select q.quote_id, q.quote_no, q.customer_id, q.project_name, q.total_amount, q.discount_amount, q.final_amount, q.status, q.version, q.submit_time, q.approve_time, q.dept_id, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.update_by, q.update_time, q.remark, c.customer_name, c.phone as customer_phone from biz_quote q left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = q.customer_id
mapper.select: where q.customer_id = #{customerId} and q.status = '2' order by q.quote_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_quote (quote_no, customer_id, project_name, total_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, version, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{quoteNo}, #{customerId}, #{projectName}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalAmount}, #{status}, #{version}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete:
delete from biz_quote where quote_id in
#{quoteId}
